title: Fredholm alternative for a general class of nonlocal operators
summary: We develop a Fredholm alternative for a fractional elliptic operator~$\mathcal{L}$ of mixed order built on the notion of fractional gradient. This operator constitutes the nonlocal extension of the classical second order elliptic operators with measurable coefficients treated by Neil Trudinger in~\cite{trudinger}. We build~$\mathcal{L}$ by weighing the order~$s$ of the fractional gradient over a measure (which can be either continuous, or discrete, or of mixed type).
